description: This file defines a React hook `useIsTabletOrMobileScreen` and a helper function `getIsTabletOrMobileScreen` to determine whether the current screen size corresponds to a tablet or mobile device, factoring in application context. It imports utility functions and application context providers, and manages window resize events to update its state accordingly.

methods.name: getIsTabletOrMobileScreen
methods.description: Determines if the application is on a tablet or mobile device based on application context and utility functions, returning an object with boolean flags.

methods.name: useIsTabletOrMobileScreen
methods.description: React hook that listens for window resize events and uses `getIsTabletOrMobileScreen` to provide current device type information.
